other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Applicant must meet the educational qualifications set by the Indian Army, Navy, or Air Force.
Applicant must meet the physical and medical standards set by the respective service.
benefits_summary: Agniveers receive a monthly customized salary with allowances, and upon completing four years they are paid a tax‑exempt Seva Nidhi package along with a non‑contributory life‑insurance cover of ₹48 lakh.
